description: This file defines a Flutter widget StatsModal that displays game statistics and guess distribution bars for a word-guessing game. It relies on a model class Stats and provides a UI modal with stats overview and a play-again button.

classes.name: StatsModal
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays game statistics, guess distributions, and a play again button in a modal dialog.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the StatsModal, including stats display, distribution bars, and a button.

methods.name: _statCard
methods.description: Helper method to create a styled statistic card with title and value.
